name: Dalos
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

defensiveAbilities.name: Magma Splash
defensiveAbilities.description: Whenever the dalos takes damage from a melee Strike, magma splashes from its open wound and sticks to nearby creatures. Each creature in a 10ft Emanation must attempt a DC 31 Reflex Saving Throw save. On a failure, the creature takes 3d6 Persistent,fire Damage damage as the superheated rock sticks to them and cools. The DC to end this persistent damage decreases by 5 each turn after the first as the magma cools.

defensiveAbilities.name: Volcanic Heat
defensiveAbilities.description: 10 feet. 3d6 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Belch Smoke
offensiveAbilities.description: The dalos blasts smoke from its head, creating a 20ft Burst of smoke that drifts to a location within 120 feet. This has the effects of Mist.

offensiveAbilities.name: Heat Rock
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dalos uses an Interact action to pluck a rock from its body or the nearby environment, then uses its internal fires to heat a rock it's holding until the rock is red hot. A heated rock that hits a target on a ranged Strike deals an additional 4d6 fire damage.

Once the dalos heats a rock, that rock retains its heat for 2 rounds before cooling.

offensiveAbilities.name: Lava Bomb
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dalos causes a volcanic explosion to erupt from its head, lobbing a mass of molten rock up to 100 feet. This lava bomb deals 6d8 Fire Damage|options:area-damage]{6d8 fire damage and 6d8 bludgeoning damage} to each creature in a 20-foot radius of its impact point, with a Basic DC 33 Reflex Saving Throw save.

The dalos can't use Lava Bomb again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Throw Rock
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

The monster picks up a rock within reach or retrieves a stowed rock and throws it, making a ranged Strike.

lv7spells.name: Earthbind
lv7spells.description:
Using the weight of earth, you hamper a target's flight, with effects based on its Fortitude save. If the creature reaches the ground safely, it doesn't take falling damage.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target falls safely up to 120 feet.

Failure The target falls safely up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it can't Fly, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target falls safely up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it can't Fly, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 minute.

lv7spells.name: Slow
lv7spells.description:
You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Slowed 1 for 1 round.

Failure The target is Slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Slowed 2 for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

lv7spells.name: Stinking Cloud
lv7spells.description:
You create a cloud of putrid mist in the area. The cloud functions as Mist except it sickens creatures that end their turns within the cloud. (The Concealed condition is not a poison effect.)

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Sickened 1.

Failure The creature is Sickened 1 and Slowed 1 while in the cloud.

Critical Failure The creature is Sickened 2 and Slowed 1 until it leaves the cloud.
